headline: Cantor Fitzgerald Maintains Neutral on Healthpeak Properties, Raises Price Target to $23
summary: Cantor Fitzgerald  analyst Richard Anderson   maintains Healthpeak Properties (NYSE:DOC) with a Neutral and raises the price target from $20 to $23.
